_comment: System hazards (common/src/ships/hazards.ts). Each system rates its hazards 0-5 (systems.json hazardRatings); places within a system can add to them (nearStar, nearBlackHole: within `radii` × the central body's radius, a rating is at least this). A ship's tolerance comes from what it's built of: its materials' hazard ratings by share of its cells (materials.json hazards), plus the bulk rules below. Rating minus tolerance (floored at 0) is the deficit; effects are per point of deficit. Cold (cryo) is the exception: it has no tolerance, it builds up on a ship over time instead (warmth, below; common/src/ships/warmth.ts).

gravitational._comment: a point per massPerPoint of mass over massFloor; mass in mass-anchor material counts double

thermal._comment: bulk soaks heat: a point for mass over massOver

electromagnetic._comment: grounded: the share of conduits in a conductive material × this

radiation.summary: Hull cells lose 0.4% HP a minute and battery capacity drops 8%, per point

thermal.summary: Beam heat builds 20% faster and shield regen drops 15%, per point

cryo.summary: Cold builds up on your ship away from heat. Below half warmth your guns recycle slower, below a quarter thrust and steering drop too, and frozen through the ship seizes up. Stars, stations and fires warm you back up; insulating materials only slow the cold

corrosive.summary: Armour cells lose 0.3% HP a minute and station repairs cost 25% more, per point

gravitational.summary: Light ships are pulled towards the well and lose 10% of their steering and thrust per point; jump range −15% a point

electromagnetic.summary: A 2-second EMP every 40 s while short

warmth._comment: Cold builds up on a ship in a cold place (common/src/ships/warmth.ts; server/src/game/Warmth.ts). Warmth runs 1 (warm) to 0 (frozen through). coldPerPoint: lost a second per point of cryo rating (rating 3: about 5 minutes from warm to frozen), × (1 - the hull's insulation, materials.json). ambient: regained a second where it isn't cold. Heat sources: regained a second near one (the best counts, and it beats the cold). seizeTicks: frozen through, how long the ship seizes up (it comes out with a little warmth back). What each stage costs is in warmth.ts WARMTH_STAGES.
